key_concepts: Heat is the transfer of thermal energy
Work is the transfer of mechanical energy
Joule's experiment showed mechanical equivalence of heat and work
Doing work on a system can raise its temperature
Heat engines use heat transfer to do work
Heat cannot be completely converted into work because some energy is wasted
Internal energy is the sum of kinetic and potential energies of particles in a system
Internal energy changes when heat is added or work is done
The first law of thermodynamics is ΔU = Q - W
In a cyclical process net heat equals net work and internal energy remains the same
Metabolizing food adds heat while the body does work
